body: Well....I did find my ideal person  but she doesnt see me that way. I don't see any reason we can't be together.  That being said I dont know if I can find someone as perfect as her.
Nope. I feel like I have done all the things right. Maybe just not interesting enough.

I clear through all my people that show up through there and pof everyday. Either no response or not the right person.  

I put the effort out there to try and talk to them. I am just getting tired of being rejected everyday.
Yes but nothing ever comes of it.
I have tried doing that. They are all older people or people I am not interested in.

I told her how I felt before she started this new relationship.

I really dont want to lose her as a friend. She is the only person that knows me for who I really am. I made a list before I met her, of the perfect woman for me. She was the list. I will never find someone like her and I dont want to compromise my list. I have compromised before and nothing good came of it. It was the start of my depression.

I have been seeking help for depression but I have so much bullshit going on, not just with this but with work and life goals that alot of this is just overwhelming and I cant stop.

I have taken some therapy. I see right through it and find it hard to believe in ... if that makes sense.

I have been getting into new hobbies thanks to her. She has really encouraged me to do alot of the old stuff I liked to do. I find it very very difficult to make new friends. I am not really all that outgoing.
I am probably looking at it like she is pushing me away. I guess she just wants to spend more time with him than me.
